data.name: Bikky
data.gender_notes: Bikky is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bik', meaning 'to shine' or 'to be powerful'. This name is associated with the god Vishnu and his avatar, Bhikshatana, who embodies the qualities of strength, courage, and generosity. The name Bikky carries the meaning “Bold, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bikky usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and the courage to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Bikky belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bold, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bikky total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
